title: Edge of Eternities Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Supervoid
entities.description: A cosmic void with a photon collar beyond which, per Xu-Ifit, existence collapses into a singular point.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: A power whose Cosmogrands always seek to expand their grip on the Edge.

entities.name: Edge of Eternities
entities.description: The region of space where this set takes place.

entities.name: Korelaa
entities.description: A prison escapee who once was held in a hardlight prison.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: A people born of dead stars who fight for light but know the void as their womb.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: A body whose inter-Pinnacle dialogs involve emissary mechans.

entities.name: Fabric of Being
entities.description: A cosmic concept described in the Drix Codex as woven by All.

entities.name: Drix Codex
entities.description: A written codex whose first line describes the Fabric of Being.

entities.name: Alpharael, Stonechosen
entities.description: A figure who embraces the truth that all things end rather than the fantasy of eternal light.

entities.name: Xu-Ifit
entities.description: An osteoharmonist who speaks of the supervoid and the singular point beyond it.

entities.name: Admiral Scargruf
entities.description: An admiral of the Kavaron Memorial Navy.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The military of Kavaron, seeking firepower to fight on Evendo.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: A degraded planet whose wasteland can no longer be saved, though its culture can.

entities.name: Tannuk, Steadfast Second
entities.description: Sami's second, who jokes about their short-handed crew.

entities.name: Sami, Wildcat Captain
entities.description: A wildcat captain who does things the hard way.

entities.name: General Tekvu
entities.description: A general of the Kavaron Memorial Navy building weapons to fight on Evendo.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: An icy planet that is thawing, home to species Kavaron's navy calls a bug infestation.

entities.name: Meltstrider
entities.description: Explorers whose log recorded finding a strange vine in the ice.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: A people for whom terraforming and evolution are one, growing as their planet grows.

entities.name: Cosmogoyf
entities.description: A dangerous creature that prompted a ship computer's final warning to run.

entities.name: PSS Erix
entities.description: A ship whose shipboard computer sent a final transmission about a Cosmogoyf.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: A group that exploited hearts poisoned by Kavaron's degradation.

entities.name: Calnan
entities.description: A Monoist assassin who preaches sekhar, the final sacrifice.

entities.name: Sekhar
entities.description: The Monoists' final sacrifice, said to grant passage to the Next Eternity.

entities.name: Next Eternity
entities.description: A destination Monoists believe is reached through sekhar.

entities.name: Godcore
entities.description: Something with maddening thoughts that drown out howling winds.

entities.name: The Endstone
entities.description: An artifact associated with a set future and uncertain present.

entities.name: Maisie's Edge Chronicles
entities.description: A travel log of worlds and moons across the Edge.

entities.name: Maisie
entities.description: Author of the Edge Chronicles travel logs.

entities.name: Granove
entities.description: A tropical moon teeming with endemic biota.

entities.name: Starshadow
entities.description: A relic of a culture lost to calamity whose people were eradicated in a single day.

entities.name: Kiln
entities.description: A world known for blazing forges and ancient lava seeps.

entities.name: Aqqat
entities.description: A newborn moon still churning with the fires of creation.

entities.name: Lammuat
entities.description: The cemetery moon of salvage and secrets.

events.summary: Beings caught in the supervoid's photon collar have time stop around them.
events.quote: As the supervoid's photon collar washed over them, time stopped.

events.summary: Korelaa escaped from a hardlight prison.
events.quote: "I have forgotten sleep in their prison." —Korelaa, prison escapee

events.summary: Admiral Scargruf leads an onslaught against the inhabitants of Evendo.
General Tekvu builds up weapons to fight on Evendo.
events.quote: "Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation."

events.summary: A Meltstrider finds and thaws a strange vine in the ice, in what became the log's final entry.
events.quote: "I've found a strange vine in the ice. Thawing for further analysis." —Meltstrider log, final entry

events.summary: The PSS Erix's computer sends a final transmission warning of a Cosmogoyf.
events.quote: >Alert: COSMOGOYF >Recommended Action: RUN —PSS *Erix* shipboard computer, final transmission

events.summary: The Monoists exploit hearts poisoned by Kavaron's degradation, leading to a mutinous massacre.
events.quote: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

events.summary: Maisie records that Starshadow's people were eradicated in a single day by an unknown calamity.
events.quote: Its people were eradicated in a single day—but by what?

relations.note: seeks to expand its grip on the Edge
relations.quote: Cosmogrands of the Celestial Palatinate always seek to expand their grip on the Edge.

relations.note: seeks to rid Evendo of its inhabitants
relations.quote: "Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation."
"We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine."

rejected.summary: The ice of Evendo thaws, unwelcome to some species.
rejected.quote: Not all species on Evendo welcomed the thawing of the ice.
